_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante : segment dominant Utility Solutions (64% du CA, expose theme grid modernization) en tete, puis Electrical Solutions, FCF (qualite cash), Backlog (visibilite), Total Net sales (reference).

kpis.signal: Segment majeur (64% CA 2024), expose au theme grid modernization et smart meters, croissance 14.7% CAGR 5 ans
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Utility Solutions Hubbell (distribution, transmission, substation, smart meters, telcom utilities). Expose aux investissements reseau et a la modernisation grid. 64% du CA consolide en 2024.
kpis.description_en: Utility Solutions segment revenue (distribution, transmission, substation, smart meters, utility telcom). Exposed to grid modernization spending. 64% of FY24 consolidated revenue.

kpis.signal: Segment cyclique (36% CA), declin 2024 lie a cession residential lighting, organic +3.8% porte par datacenter et renewables
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Electrical Solutions (wiring devices, connecteurs, equipement industriel/datacenter). 36% du CA 2024. Decline -3.9% lie a cession residential lighting Q1 2024, organic +3.8% drive par datacenter et renewables.
kpis.description_en: Electrical Solutions segment revenue (wiring devices, connectors, industrial/datacenter gear). 36% of FY24 revenue. -3.9% from residential lighting divestiture Q1 2024, organic +3.8% on datacenter and renewables strength.

kpis.signal: CAGR 5 ans +11.2%, accelere par M&A (Northern Star FY23) et theme grid
kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires consolide. Croissance soutenue portee par acquisitions (Systems Control, EI Electronics, Balestro) et theme grid modernization.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated net sales. Sustained growth driven by acquisitions (Systems Control, EI Electronics, Balestro) and grid modernization theme.

kpis.signal: Generation cash de qualite, conversion 104% du net income 2024, support dividende + buybacks
kpis.description_fr: Free cash flow continuing operations (cash from ops - capex). Conversion 104% net income 2024. Finance dividende ($267M) et rachats actions.
kpis.description_en: Free cash flow continuing operations (cash from ops less capex). 104% conversion of net income in 2024. Funds dividend ($267M) and buybacks.

kpis.signal: Normalisation post-pic 2022, visibilite courte sauf $70M long terme meters Utility
kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes ferme au 31 decembre. Pic 2022 a $2.46Mds (supply chain backlog), normalisation 2024. Majorite a livrer en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Firm order backlog at December 31. Peaked at $2.46B in 2022 (supply chain backlog), normalizing in 2024. Most shippable in 2025.
